== Biography ==
===2019 Season===
Owo joined the [[Suning-S]] in 2019, but didn’t start until LDL summer that year. With a deep champion pool, a calm personality and composed gameplays, He helped them win the third place in [[LDL/2019 Season/Summer Playoffs|LDL 2019 Summer Playoffs]].

===2020 Season===
Owo continued to play in [[Suning-S]] throughout the shortened [[LDL/2020 Season/Spring Season|LDL 2020 Spring Season]]. He then was officially promoted to [[Suning]] at the beginning of Summer Season, but didn’t play one game for the team. Subsequently, he served as a substitute for them in the [[2020 Season World Championship]].

** The 6th player to reach 6000 assists in the LPL.
* Reached 300 wins in the LPL on May 31, 2025.
** Was the 24th player to reach 300 wins in the LPL.
* Reached 500 games in the LPL on August 13, 2025.
** The 37th player to reach 500 games in the LPL.
* Reached 1000 international assists during [[2025 Mid-Season Invitational|MSI 2025]] on July 06, 2025 in Upper Bracket Round 2 against [[T1]], becoming the 9th player to achieve this milestone after [[Ming (Shi Sen-Ming)|Ming]], Faker, [[xiaohu]], [[meiko]], [[Keria]], [[Caps]], [[Canyon]], and [[Oner]]. Reached it in the same game as Oner.
